## What it is

Boîtier alimentation, cavité 50 × 87,6 mm dérivée de `bb_overall()` (pas un slider) : X = RAC05-05SK 21,8 + `recom_rac05_rayon_min` 28,2 ; Y = `helu145_rayon_min` 21,6 + baie 221-415 19,0 + mur + PSU 27,8 + mur + deux 221-423 16,0. Murs et fond 1,6 mm, 40 mm de haut. Origine = coin intérieur sud-ouest. Trois baies est-alignées, ouvertures 5 mm au seuil 15 mm au-dessus du fond (Z = 16,6) : sud X = 45 → 50, ouest Y = 0 → 5, ouest Y = 82,6 → 87,6. Canal filaire au nord, fermé par le couvercle.

## Design notes

Printed floor on the bed. Inner origin (0, 0). `bb_overall()` / `bb_wago_south()` / `bb_psu()` / `bb_wago_north()` from `measurements.toml` (RAC05-05SK, Wago, `recom_rac05_rayon_min`, `helu145_rayon_min`) plus two 1.6 mm separator walls — not constructor params. Outer 53.2 × 97.4 × 41.6 with the north channel. Inner 50 × 87.6. PSU volume is 21.8 × 27.8 × 35 mm, X = 28.2 → 50, Y = 42.2 → 70. The X = 28.2 face is the right edge of a 1.6 mm réglette, not its centre. PSU north wall: south face at Y = 70, thickness toward +Y, only alim_x wide (plus overlap into the east outer wall), alim_z = 35 mm above the floor. Extra 17.6 mm of cavity north of Y = 70 (the 1.6 mm wall sits in that, leaving 16 mm wall-to-wall). Battery / Wago-stop wall: north face at Y = 42.2, 32.5 mm tall like the vertical Wago wall, thickness 1.6 mm toward −Y (south face at 40.6). Clear Y gap 19.0 mm face-to-face, so the lower 15 mm wall has its north face at 21.6 (south at 20.0). Two 15 mm Y-rails under the Wago, 1.6 mm thick, 5 mm off the west wall (X = 20.2) and the east inner wall (X = 50), so those walls can flex; the 15 mm south wall is flush with the rails (no 1 mm lip). Wago width 29.8 mm from inner X max (221-415 30 mm with −0.2 press-fit): right face of the vertical wall at X = 20.2. The 16 mm south réglette and that wall meet as a full-thickness L (outer corner X = 18.6, Y = 20.0), not a T. 1 mm lip toward +X, 45° lead-in, only 8 mm along Y at the north of the wall (exposed Y = 32.6 → 40.6); the south of the bay stays open so the terminals tilt in. Three standing Ø8.2 magnet wells (`add_well`, 0.6 mm bed skin): Wago bay centre at (35.1, 31.1), plus (10, 30) and (10, 60) from the inner SW origin. North bay: two 221-423 on edge, outputs west, X = 18.6 (`wago_profondeur`), Y = 16 wall-to-wall (two 8.0 mm bodies), Z = 19.8 above the 15 mm platform (18.8 mm body + 1 mm under the catch). Two 15 mm X-rails fused into the east wall, 5 mm off the north wall and the PSU wall. West muret 15 mm (flush with the platform) running in Y, east face at X = 31.4. One 1 mm / 45° lip on the outer north wall only, 8 mm from inner X max, at floor + 15 + 19.8. Cable openings start 15 mm above the floor (Z = 16.6 from the bed), not at the platform. Three openings: south 5 mm flush right (X = 45 → 50); west 5 mm at Y = 0 → 5; west 5 mm at Y = 82.6 → 87.6 (up to inner Y max), so the north wall meets the west wall. 0.6 mm chamfer on the jambs and sills of all three. Two heat-insert bays via `add_corbel(..., flush=True)`: bore flush with the inner face so the 1.6 mm wall is the outer insert wall. West bay centred on Y = 60. South bay east edge at X = 40. One cable-tie U per opening via `add_hook`, 10 mm from the corner. Polish 1 mm on the four outer vertical corners. Construction: separator walls, internals (`add_wall` + two `surplomb`), wells, hooks, corbels, openings, then the unpolished north channel.

## Don't

- Do not put `longueur_interne` / `largeur_interne` / `alim_*` back on the constructor: inner size is `bb_overall()` from `recom_rac05_*`, Wago cotes, `recom_rac05_rayon_min` and `helu145_rayon_min`. `couvercle_ps` imports that bbox.
- Do not change `_WALL` to 1.68: `bb_overall` counts two 1.6 mm separator walls; `epaisseur_paroi=1.68` would drift the outer size.
- Do not size the south bay from `wago_415_largeur` (30) or `wago_profondeur` (18.6): it is 29.8 × 19.0 (`boitier_ps_wago_largeur` / `boitier_ps_wago_entre_murets`), press-fit.
- Do not inline the Wago catch: `system.surplomb` / `surplomb_xz` (shared with `boitier_dc`).
- Do not call `add_corbel` without `flush=True`: the bore is flush with the inner face so the 1.6 mm wall is the outer insert wall.
- Do not treat 50 × 70 as inner: inner is 50 × 87.6. Outer with the north channel is 53.2 × 97.4.
- Do not treat 50 × 70 as outer: they were inner before the north extension.
- Do not centre the PSU réglette on X = 28.2: the right face is at 28.2 (50 − 21.8).
- Do not put the 5 mm south opening off Y min: it is flush right, X = 45 → 50, not the old 10 mm (X = 40 → 50).
- Do not treat Y = 42.2 or X = 28.2 as muret centres: 42.2 is the north face of the battery wall. The 19.0 mm is the clear gap, not centre-to-centre.
- Do not put the Y gap back to 19.8 mm or 20 mm: 19.0 mm is the intended face-to-face.
- Do not put PSU Y back to 28 mm: 27.8 mm is the intended pocket (south face at 42.2, north at 70).
- Do not put the PSU X pocket back to 28 mm (réglette at 22): it is 21.8 mm, right face at 28.2.
- Do not leave the Y = 42.2 wall at 17.5 mm, nor drop either Wago wall back to 17 or 17.5 from the floor: both are 32.5 mm (17.5 above the 15 mm rails) so the lip sits 0.5 mm above two stacked 8.4 mm terminals.
- Do not fill the Wago bay with a solid 15 mm block: two Y-rails, 5 mm off the west and east walls so those walls can flex; do not glue the rails back to the side walls.
- Do not put the front Wago lip back to 16 mm unless asked: it is 15 mm, flush with the platform, so the terminals come out. The 1 mm catch on the tall walls stays.
- Do not join the 15 mm south réglette to the west Wago wall with only the 0.4 mm boolean overlap: they are a full-thickness L, each running to the other's outer face, so the outer corner is one edge (and takes the 1 mm polish).
- Do not take 29.8 mm from inner Y. It is 50 − 29.8 along X, and that coordinate is the right face.
- Do not go back to 28.8 mm of Wago width: the 221-415 needs 29.8 mm (30 − 0.2).
- Do not model the 1 mm Wago lip as a square shelf: 45° underneath.
- Do not run the Z lip the full length of the Y-wall: only 8 mm at the north, so the Wagos can tilt in.
- Do not flush the north-west opening with Y max, nor cut through the north wall: it is 5 mm, Y = 81.0 → 86.0 (1.6 mm south of inner Y max), so the north face runs to the west corner. Not 10 mm (Y = 76 → 86).
- Do not chamfer the opening lips 1 mm: the wall is 1.6 mm, so inner and outer 1 mm collide. 0.6 mm on jambs and sills.
- Do not skip the opening chamfers: the sharp lips cut cable sheaths.
- Do not run the cable openings down to the floor or to the 15 mm platform: all three start at 15 mm above the floor (Z = 16.6 from the bed). Do not put the sill back to 25 mm (seuil plus bas, 2026-09-05).
- Do not run the PSU north wall the full inner X: only alim_x (21.8 mm), east-aligned.
- Do not flush the PSU with the new inner Y max: the 17.6 mm surplus is north of Y = 70 (16 mm clear).
- Do not put inner Y back to 86.8 / surplus 16.8: that was 15.2 mm wall-to-wall. The north Wagos need 16 mm.
- Do not add a lid unless asked.
- Do not drop the magnet wells: three Ø8.2 standing wells, 0.6 mm skin, at the Wago bay centre (35.1, 31.1) and at (10, 30) and (10, 60) from the inner SW origin.
- Do not reintroduce `puit_diametre` (or `puit_debout`): well size comes from `measurements.toml` via `add_well`.
- Do not put the west wells back to X = 15: the Ø8.2 bore nicked the Wago wall. They sit at X = 10.
- Do not run the north-bay lip the full inner X: only 8 mm from the east, same `wago_surplomb_longueur` as the south bay.
- Do not put the PSU-wall lip back on the north bay: one catch on the outer north wall is enough; the terminals tilt in from the west.
- Do not glue the north X-rails to the north wall or the PSU wall: 5 mm off, same `wago_rail_ecart` as the south bay.
- Do not measure `nord_wago_z` from the floor: it is 19.8 mm above the 15 mm platform (18.8 mm body + 1 mm). The catch sits at floor + 15 + 19.8.
- Do not drop the north catch back to 18.8 mm above the platform: the extra millimetre is so it clears the 221-423.
- Do not take `nord_wago_x` from the 221-415 width: it is 18.6 mm (221-423 depth, outputs west).
- Do not run the cable openings down to the floor: they start at 15 mm above the floor, not at the 15 mm Wago platform.
- Do not model the lid inserts as towers from the floor: 45° corbels from the west and south inner faces.
- Do not put the west insert off Y = 60: it matches puit_y_nord, not the south well.
- Do not put the south insert's east edge anywhere but X = 40 (10 mm from the east). It is not tied to the 5 mm opening.
- Do not model those lips as square shelves: 1 mm catch, 45° underneath, same as the 221-415.
- Do not put the anti-tirage on the outer face, nor skip one: south at X = 10, east at Y = 10, north at X = 10, one per opening.
- Do not duplicate the cable-tie U in the part file: `system.add_hook` wraps `anti_tirage_ns` / `anti_tirage_ew`.
- Do not open the anti-tirage sides: the 1.3 mm walls stay. The tie exits vertically through the open top (same 3 mm as the bottom), not sideways.
- Do not let the lower anti-tirage subtract eat the wall: stop at the inner face. Extra margin in +Y (north) or +X (east) nicks the face.
- Do not drop the 1.2 mm gap to 1 mm: the tie is 1 mm thick.
